```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(CrossCurveR)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

```{r}
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv", 
  fra = "fra-bs.csv"
)

curves <- names(curve_files)
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)

start_date <- as.Date("2010-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2020-12-31")
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.15, by = 0.005)
cutoffs <- c(4, 8)
ref = "usa"

yields <- lapply(curve_files, function(file_name) {
  dr_read_yields(here::here("reconstructed_data", file_name))
})

yields <- lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
  curve_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.Date(time) >= start_date,
      as.Date(time) <= end_date
    )
})

## truncated yields: window only 
years <- 2010:2020

annual_yields <- setNames(lapply(years, function(year) {
  lapply(yields, function(curve_df) {
    curve_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(format(as.Date(time), "%Y") == as.character(year))
  })
}), years)

```

```{r}
set.seed(999) 

year2015 <- annual_yields[["2015"]]
dly2015 <- dly_fit(yields = year2015, mats = mats, lambdas = lambdas, reference = ref)
mce2015 <- mc_fit_end(yields = year2015, mats = mats, lambdas = lambdas, curves = names(year2015), cutoffs = cutoffs, reference = ref, 
                      X_trunc = TRUE, Xt_smooth = FALSE, CR_S0_shrink_diag = 0.4)

```
